description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the TargetVolumeSegment operation
description_zh: 本文介绍放疗靶区勾画TargetVolumeSegment的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imageprocess target-volume-segment --url-list URL=https://medclients-sh.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/demo/xxx/0001.dcm --data-format DICOM --cancer-type LUNG --target-volume-type GTV --org-id 1 --org-name 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TargetVolumeSegment

fields.help_en:
A list of DICOM file URLs or NIFTI file URLs in the format ["url","url",...].
We recommend that you use OSS links in the China (Shanghai) region. If the files are stored locally or in an OSS region other than China (Shanghai), refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

N in URLList.N.URL indicates the sequence number of the image URL in the current list (starting from 1). When you directly use the API, specify the URLList parameters in the format of URLList.1.URL=url1&URLList.2.URL=url2&..., where url1 and url2 are actual values. When you use an SDK, use the corresponding methods provided by the SDK to populate the URLList
fields.help_zh:
DICOM序列文件URL列表或NIFTI文件URL列表["url","url",...]。
推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

URLList.N.URL中的N为该图像URL在当前List中的顺序（从1开始）。当直接使用API请求时，输入URLList的填充会以URLList.1.URL=url1，URLList.2.URL=url2，......的方式指定参数和参数值，参数对以&连接，其中url1、url2、......等具体值请根据实际情况进行替换；当使用SDK填充URLList时，可直接使用SDK提供的相应的方法
fields.name: url

parameters.help_en: The format of the image. Valid values: DICOM and NIFTI
parameters.name: data_format

parameters.help_en:
The cancer type. Valid values: Eso, Lung, and Breast. Currently, only Lung is supported.
Eso: esophageal cancer.
Lung: lung cancer.
Breast: breast cancer
parameters.help_zh:
癌症类型。包括Eso、Lung和Breast等，当前只支持Lung。
Eso：食管癌
Lung：肺癌
Breast：乳腺癌
parameters.name: cancer_type

parameters.help_en:
The target volume type. Valid values: GTV, CTV, and PTV. Currently, only GTV is supported.
GTV: Gross Tumor Volume.
CTV: Clinical Target Volume.
PTV: Planning Target Volume
parameters.help_zh:
目标体积类型。包括GTV、CTV和PTV，当前只支持GTV。
GTV：肿瘤区（Gross Tumor Volume）
CTV：临床靶区（Clinical Target Volume）
PTV：计划靶区（Planning Target Volume）
parameters.name: target_volume_type

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the sub-channel (organization, such as a hospital) under the current channel (Alibaba Cloud account)
parameters.help_zh: 当前渠道（即主账号）下的子渠道（即机构，如医院）标识
parameters.name: org_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the sub-channel (organization, such as a hospital) under the current channel (Alibaba Cloud account)
parameters.help_zh: 当前渠道（即主账号）下的子渠道（即机构，如医院）名称
parameters.name: org_name

Data.description_en: The returned data. After the asynchronous task is executed successfully, call the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain this data
Data.description_zh: 返回的结果数据内容。该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

ResultURL.description_en:
The HTTP URL of the segmentation mask file in NIFTI format.

This URL is a temporary address that is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL is no longer accessible. To save the file for a longer period or permanently, access the URL within 30 minutes and download the file to your own OSS bucket or other storage
ResultURL.description_zh:
NIFTI格式的分割mask文件HTTP地址。

该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
